text: hexa-lang 5-LANE 최전선 (3lane 셀프호스트 + 2lane 언어). ▸L1 axis-③ own-emit(clang 0): native ELF 인코더 elf_x86_64.hexa 정답지(tcc/QBE/Intel-SDM) reference-match 완성·#4790 label_bkt로 label-resolve벽 종결·#4794 cg_profile sub-marks로 잔존 phase 측정→aiden self-emit .o 생성 판정. ▸L2 axis-① native-serve(C fallback 0=hexa_cc.c 제거): ③ end-to-end 켜지면 C-transpile delegate 제거. ▸L3 axis-② runtime.c→0: RFC061 standalone-ABI 대공사(Route C codegen C-ABI native-emit로 ~210 libc-floor fn 포팅·sanctioned-terminal 거부·user결정)·Fable 라운드맵 설계중. ▸L4 정적타입(static typing): 타입시스템 강화→boxed-HexaVal 언박싱 레버(컴파일타임 타입확정→16B/kernel tax 제거)·measure-first. ▸L5 메모리관리(memory management): borrow-check/ownership(E0382 partial-move·HX30xx 시리즈·region/arena 추론)로 GC-free 메모리안전. 공통규율=byteeq 3-target GREEN+shipping smoke·no-LLVM inviolable·measure not LLM.
